blocks.prompt: 1. A sum of Rs.10400 is paid off in 40 instalment such that each instalment is Rs.10 more than the preceding instalment. Calculate the value of the first instalment.
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke yeh kis qism ka sawal hai. Har instalment (qist) pichhli qist se pakke Rs. 10 zyada hai, yani har dafa ek hi fixed raqam judti hai. Jab har qadam par barabar raqam jude to list A.P. banti hai.
Sari 40 qistein mil kar Rs. 10400 banti hain, is liye 10400 kisi ek term ki nahi balke 40 terms ke jama (sum) ki qeemat hai.
Plan: \(n\), \(d\) aur \(S_n\) pehchanenge, sum ka formula lagayenge aur pehli qist \(a_1\) nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 40 qistein, har qist pichhli se Rs. 10 zyada, kul raqam Rs. 10400.
Humein find karna hai: pehli qist \(a_1\).
Tareeqa: A.P. ke sum ka formula \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a_1 + (n - 1)d]\). Is mein \(a_1\), \(d\), \(n\) aur kul jama sab aate hain, aur hamare paas sirf \(a_1\) maloom nahi, is liye yahi formula sab se seedha rasta hai.

Kahani ko A.P. ki zubaan mein likhein
\[n = 40,\quad d = 10\]
\[S_{40} = 10400,\quad a_1 = ?\]
Kyun: "40 instalment" ka matlab terms ki tadaad \(n = 40\). "Rs. 10 more than the preceding" ka matlab har term pichhle se 10 zyada, yani common difference \(d = 10\). "Rs. 10400 paid off" ka matlab sari qistein jama ho kar 10400, yani \(S_{40} = 10400\). Kahani ke har jumle ko ek symbol mein badalna hi aise sawalon ki asal kunji hai.

Values sum ke formula mein rakhein
\[\dfrac{40}{2}[2a_1 + 39(10)] = 10400\]
\[20(2a_1 + 390) = 10400\]
Kyun: Formula mein \(n = 40\) rakha to bahar \(\frac{40}{2} = 20\) aaya aur andar \((n - 1)d = 39 \times 10 = 390\). Ab sirf ek unknown \(a_1\) bacha hai, to yeh ek seedhi linear equation hai.

\(a_1\) nikalein
\[2a_1 + 390 = 520\]
\[2a_1 = 130\]
\[a_1 = 65\]
Kyun: Dono taraf 20 se divide kiya to \(10400 \div 20 = 520\). Phir 390 dono taraf se ghataya aur aakhir mein 2 se divide kiya. Har qadam par dono taraf ek hi kaam karte hain taake equation ka tawazun (balance) qaim rahe.
Dhyan dein: \(20(2a_1 + 390)\) ko kholte waqt 20 ko dono terms se multiply karna hota hai; behtar yeh hai ke pehle 20 se divide kar lein, hisaab chhota rehta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[a_{40} = 65 + 39(10) = 455\]
\[S_{40} = \dfrac{40}{2}(65 + 455)\]
\[= 20 \times 520 = 10400 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Pehle aakhri qist nikali: \(a_{40} = 455\). Phir doosra formula \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}(\text{pehla} + \text{aakhri})\) lagaya aur wahi 10400 mila. Do mukhtalif raston se ek hi jawab aaye to yaqeen ho jata hai ke jawab sahi hai.
